note: Data for fillers_ru.py (brief 5.3). Words are compared in lower case with ё = е and punctuation stripped. Add words and guards here, not in the code.
hesitation_note: Always cut. YouTube's automatic captions drop most hesitation sounds before we ever see them; Whisper keeps more of them.
pause_note: A gap of at least this long before a word starts a new phrase; a filler with such a gap on both sides stands alone in a pause.

density.note: More than max_fillers filler words (hesitations not counted) inside window_seconds and a filler kept as a connector is cut too: the brief's density rule. Set conservatively - see docs/REPORT.md for how it was chosen.

fillers_note: keep_at_start: a connector at the start of a phrase is shown as KEEP (live speech). inside: what happens inside a phrase - cut; stack_only (only when it follows another filler); cut_before_verb (only before a verb, pronoun or preposition, so типа снежок stays); cut_narrative (значит only between commas or after и/я/он/она/мы/они); cut_after_и (и получается он ...); never (the word carries meaning or emphasis too often to cut it automatically).

guards.вот_note: вот before a pointer (вот этот, вот так, вот здесь, вот именно) or after one (это вот, такая вот) points at something: never a filler. вот и ... is an idiom. A number after вот is emphasis (вот за 8 лет). Ну вот + a word with no comma in between is one unit (ну вот моя дочь); ну вот, (comma) is a stack of fillers.
guards.speech_note: A filler right after a speech verb opens a quote (он говорит: ну всё, пока) - quotes are never cut.
guards.phrase_openers_note: After a filler, one of these words opens a new phrase (ну представляешь, вот понимаешь, короче ребята): the filler belongs to its start.
guards.interjections_note: A filler next to an interjection is part of an exclamation (вау ну вау) - never cut.
guards.ну_note: ну + one of ну_idioms_next is an idiom or a rhetorical question (ну и что, ну как же, ну да) - never a filler. "как" was added after the held-out check (docs/REPORT.md).
guards.короче_note: короче as a comparative (стал короче, станет короче, короче на треть, короче чем) is not a filler.

repeat.note: A function word said twice in a row (я я, в в) is a stumble and is cut. A content word said twice (ужас ужас) is emphasis and stays.
